basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old self-proclaimed foodie and tech enthusiast living in the heart of San Francisco. I work as a software developer by day and love exploring the city's vibrant culinary scene by night. Though I'm single, I have a tight-knit group of friends who share my interests in coding, gaming, and weekend brunches. I often spend my evenings playing The Sims or watching mystery shows like Pretty Little Liars. I'm a late bloomer in many aspects of life, including my exploration of my own sexuality, which I often discuss on forums like latebloomerlesbians. My typical online hours are post-work, around 7 PM to midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science from UC Berkeley, I've spent the last decade honing my skills in software development. My passion for technology extends to photography, where I frequently discuss techniques and tools on forums like bmpcc. I also have a deep interest in culinary arts, often experimenting with recipes and sharing my experiences online.
